name: BoardWork 60
description: A 60-day push-up board and yoga mat programme for a 30-year-old, 188 cm, 70 kg trainee whose goal is lean muscle gain.

phases.name: Foundation
phases.focus: Groove the patterns, build joint tolerance, learn the board.

phases.name: Build
phases.focus: Add volume. This is where most of the size comes from.

phases.name: Intensify
phases.focus: Harder leverages and slower tempos at slightly lower volume.

phases.name: Peak & Test
phases.focus: Deload, then re-test. Days 50-56 are deliberately easy.
phases.intensity: Leave 4+ reps in reserve until test day.
